name: Rules first; model suggests one object only on empty rule selection
annotationPolicy: Required groups and optional supports fixed before inference; not reviewed by user.
existingResults: comparison.json may be replayed for exploratory reference only; not used for tuning.
gate: rules.selected.length === 0; partial nonempty selections are unchanged
candidate: highest cosine score among available objects, after excludedObjectIds from current rules
simpleFallback: top1 with threshold 0.20, no margin gate; fixed before experiment
objective: useful primary suggestions - 2 * non-useful suggestions on calibration fallback cases only; ties: fewer non-useful, more useful, higher absolute threshold, higher margin
usefulSuggestion: Not abstention reference, no forbidden objects and covers at least one required group. Optional support alone is not a useful primary suggestion.
interpretation: Suggestion requires user confirmation; combined scene success is hypothetical acceptance, not automatic product success.
